# The Goodson Blogson

> A legal updates and resources blog from Duke Law's Goodson Law Library covering new legislation, Supreme Court developments, bar exam preparation, and curated reading recommendations for law students and legal professionals.

The Goodson Blogson is the official blog of Goodson Law Library at Duke Law School, providing timely coverage of legislative changes, judicial developments, and library resources. The blog serves Duke Law students, faculty, and the broader legal community with practical guides, curated recommendations, and access information for legal research tools.

## Key Topics

- Goodson Law Library
- Duke Law
- Legal Updates
- New Legislation
- Bar Exam Preparation
- Legal Research
- Supreme Court (SCOTUS)
- Law Students
- North Carolina Legislation
- StateScape
- LegiScan
- Bluebook Citation
- Winter Reading Recommendations
- Holiday Gift Guide
- Legal Research Databases

## Legislative Updates & Legal News

- [New Laws in the New Year](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/12/new-laws-in-new-year.html): Overview of new state laws effective in 2026 across California, Oregon, Illinois
- [First Monday in October](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/09/first-monday-in-october.html): Supreme Court October Term 2025 preview with case summaries and SCOTUS resources
- [Executive Orders and Presidential Legal Challenges](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/02): Executive orders and presidential legal challenges tracked via Law360 database

## Bar Exam & Academic Preparation

- [Bar Exam Prep Resources](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/06): Bar exam prep resources including Bluebook citation and UBE study materials
- [Law School Exam Prep Guide](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2024/11): Law school exam prep guide with study aids and holiday gift recommendations
- [Legal Writing Competitions and Scholarships](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/05): Legal writing competitions and scholarship opportunities for law students

## Legal Research Resources & Tools

- [Summer Access Guide to Legal Research Databases](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/04): Summer access guide to Westlaw, Lexis, and legal research resources for Duke Law
- [The Atlantic Subscription Access](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/01): Announcement of The Atlantic subscription access via Duke University Libraries

## Reading Recommendations & Staff Picks

- [Winter Break Reading Recommendations](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/11/winter-break-reading-recommendations.html): Goodson Law Library staff picks for fiction and nonfiction winter reading
- [Holiday Gift Guide for Lawyers & Law Students](https://dukelawref.blogspot.com/2025/10/holiday-gift-guide-for-lawyers-law.html): Holiday gift ideas and charitable giving suggestions for legal professionals
